proposedSkills.name: Mutation-Based Test Adequacy
proposedSkills.description: Determines whether a change is actually covered by its tests by injecting controlled faults into the changed lines of a disposable copy, running the suite against each mutant, and iterating until surviving mutants are killed or reported as reproducible gaps.

evidence.notes: MIT-licensed Python/pytest skill backed by a mutation-testing CLI, replay commands, isolated copies, tests, pre-registrations and published experiment artifacts. Benchmarks are first-party and not independently replicated.
Third-party directory identifies and distributes a repackaged 'verify a change' skill attributed to the timini upstream. This is a downstream reference, not verified active usage.
Original author disclosed and discussed the benchmark publicly on 2026-10-16, including a negative primary result and tradeoffs. Author-originated discussion is not independent validation.
